title: Viewport Texture Size Error (scale value of viewport was squared?)
body:
### Tested versions

Godot v4.5.stable.mono

Godot v4.4.1.stable.mono

Godot v4.3.stable.mono 

Godot v4.3.stable (77dcf97d8) 

### System information

Windows 11 (build 26100) - Multi-window, 1 monitor - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3050 Laptop GPU (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.6094) - AMD Ryzen 7 5800U with Radeon Graphics (16 threads) - 15.35 GiB memory  

### Issue description

https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/94245#issuecomment-2395261134

Stretch mode: CanvasItem

```gdscript
func _process(delta: float) -> void:
	var unit = get_viewport().get_texture().get_size() / Vector2(get_viewport_rect().size)
	$CanvasLayer/Control/GlowProcess.get_material().set_shader_parameter("unit", unit)
	print(unit)
```

For 480 * 270 viewport size, the maximized window (1920 * 1080) should print unit = 4 (actually 3.xxx, because maximized window != full screen). 

Behaviours:
- 4.3: print (3.66875, 3.67037) , scale ≈ 4 （1920/480=1080/270=4）
- 4.4.1: print (13.46042, 13.47407)  ，scale ≈ 16
- 4.5: print (13.46042, 13.47407)  ，scale≈16
> Looks like the scale value was squared. 
```gdscript
	var unit = get_viewport().get_texture().get_size() / Vector2(get_viewport_rect().size)
	unit.x = sqrt(unit.x)
	unit.y = sqrt(unit.y)
	print(unit)
```
> This solution looks better. But not sure whether it is correct for other resolutions. 


> Resolution: 1920 * 1080
> print(get_viewport().get_texture().get_size()) 
> result of maximized window: (6461.0, 3638.0). Version: 4.4.1 (mono)/4.5 (mono) 
> result of maximized window: (1761, 991). Version: 4.3 (steam)/4.3 (mono)

### Steps to reproduce

See mrp.
